rounds.text: Kaushalya Logistics Ltd is currently trading at a significant valuation discount, with a P/E ratio of 4.83x compared to the sector benchmark of 26.12x [E6], and a P/B ratio of 0.81x against the sector's 2.28x [E7]. This undervaluation is starkly highlighted by a discounted cash flow analysis suggesting an intrinsic value of Rs 264 per share, providing an 84% margin of safety against the current price of Rs 42.1 [E40, E41]. The company demonstrates robust operational efficiency, evidenced by an ROE of 18.36% and an ROCE of 16.7%, both of which substantially outperform their respective sector benchmarks [E9, E10]. Furthermore, the business has achieved exceptional top-line expansion, with compounded sales growth reaching 140% over the last five years and 104% over the trailing twelve months [E14, E16]. While the stock price has faced recent volatility, the current price sits above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages, indicating positive technical momentum [E45]. Conceded: the company faces leverage risk with a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.01x [E32], a lack of dividend payouts [E4, E57], and a concerning cash conversion ratio of 0.33x [E28].
